2. CORE SERVICES & CAPABILITIES
========================================================================
1. Sales-Converting Websites (A.I.D.A. Framework):
   - Bespoke premium designs with modern glassmorphism, 3D visual depth, scroll-driven animations, and mobile-first speed (<0.5s custom code).
   - Engineered specifically to convert traffic into WhatsApp leads, bookings, and paid orders.
2. Custom Web Applications & Internal Business Systems:
   - Online booking engines, real-time rental timer systems, CRM & ERP dashboards, agent & affiliate commission portals, inventory tracking, and custom CMS admin panels—built at affordable SME & enterprise pricing.
3. 24/7 Custom AI Chatbots & WhatsApp Automation:
   - Business-trained conversational AI integrated with web & WhatsApp to answer customer questions instantly (even at 2:00 AM), qualify leads, calculate rates, and dispatch bookings.
4. Triple-Search Visibility Engineering (SEO + AEO + GEO):
   - SEO: Google Search optimization targeting Johor Bahru, Malaysia & Singapore buyer keywords, semantic HTML, fast performance, and image-rich XML sitemaps.
   - AEO (Answer Engine Optimization): FAQPage schema, Speakable markup, and concise answer architecture to win Google AI Overviews and Featured Snippets.
   - GEO (Generative Engine Optimization): Structured JSON-LD knowledge graphs, AI-friendly robots.txt, and llms.txt / llms-full.txt so ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity accurately cite and recommend the business.
5. Backend APIs, Cloud Databases & Payment Integrations:
   - High-concurrency backend APIs, Malaysian FPX & Stripe payment integrations, secure cloud databases, and dedicated 24/7 IT support.
